# Stellar Property Management

> Licensed community association management for condominium, HOA, and townhome associations in Chicago and the North Shore of Illinois.

Stellar Property Management serves community association boards. The company does not market residential rental management services.

## Publishing and attribution

Articles cover Illinois condominium, HOA, and townhome association governance, finances, maintenance, compliance, and board operations. Article byline: Mirsad Cerimovic, CAM, CMCA, AMS. Publisher: Stellar Property Management.
